query:
SELECT
            kind        AS "kind!: String",
            evidence    AS "evidence!: serde_json::Value",
            detected_at AS "detected_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
        FROM observations
        WHERE kind IN (
            'image_hash_cluster', 'account_cohort',
            'reply_brigade',      'report_volume_anomaly'
        )
        ORDER BY detected_at DESC
        LIMIT $1
